project_metadata.title: Smart Voice Navigation AI Agent Prototype

scenarios.title: Personalized Departure Route Suggestion
scenarios.user_utterance: Guide me the route from my home (Gangnam Station, Seoul) to Gyeongju.
scenarios.architecture_route: Driver (Voice) <-> GPT-Realtime-2.1 <-> AI Gateway <-> Function Calling & text-embedding-3-small <-> Customer Back-End

tool_definition.name: get_personalized_route
tool_definition.description: Calculates optimal route from origin to destination reflecting driver preference history.

scenarios.agent_voice_response: I found the best route to Gyeongju via Gyeongbu Expressway. The total distance is 346 kilometers, and it will take about 3 hours and 38 minutes. Let's begin navigation.

scenarios.title: Dynamic Congestion Detour Re-routing
scenarios.user_utterance: Looks like we hit traffic near Daejeon. Please find an alternate route.
scenarios.architecture_route: Driver <-> GPT-Realtime-2.1 / GPT-6 Sol <-> AI Gateway <-> Function Calling (Auto-reroute Module) <-> Traffic Back-End

tool_definition.name: reroute_optimal_path
tool_definition.description: Calculates real-time bypass route upon severe congestion or traffic incident.

mock_backend_response.detour_path: Dangjin-Yeongdeok Expressway bypass via South Daejeon IC

scenarios.agent_voice_response: Heavy congestion is detected 3 kilometers ahead due to an accident. Switching to the bypass via Dangjin-Yeongdeok Expressway will save you 22 minutes. Rerouting now.

scenarios.title: Real-time POI & Fuel Price Grounding
scenarios.user_utterance: We're almost at Gyeongju, but low on fuel. Any nearby gas stations and their prices?
scenarios.architecture_route: Driver <-> GPT-Realtime-2.1 <-> AI Gateway <-> OpenAI Web Search Tool

tool_definition.name: search_nearby_amenities
tool_definition.description: Searches real-time POIs such as gas stations with live unit prices within driving vicinity.

stations.name: Alttul Self Gas Station (Gyeongju IC Branch)

scenarios.agent_voice_response: You have about 38 kilometers of fuel remaining. The cheapest option nearby is Alttul Self Station right off Gyeongju IC, 1.8 kilometers away, at 1,589 won per liter. Would you like me to set it as a waypoint?

scenarios.title: Low-Latency In-Vehicle Fatigue Chit-Chat
scenarios.user_utterance: I'm getting really tired. Tell me a trending, funny joke.
scenarios.architecture_route: Driver <-> GPT-Realtime-2.1 (Fast Path) / routed to GPT-6 Luna via AI Gateway
scenarios.agent_voice_response: Why do trees make terrible road trip buddies? Because they always get stuck barking orders and never branch out of the slow lane! Hang in there, Ronald! We're only 15 minutes away from Gyeongju. Roll down the window for some fresh air, or would you like some upbeat driving music?

scenarios.title: Driving Telemetry Summary & Email Delivery
scenarios.agent_arrival_prompt: We've safely arrived in Gyeongju! Total driving time was 3 hours and 48 minutes with an Eco-score of 88. Would you like me to send the full driving summary report to your email?
scenarios.architecture_route: Customer Back-End (Telemetry) <-> AI Gateway <-> GPT-6 Sol <-> Function Calling (send_trip_summary_email) <-> Driver Email

tool_definition.name: send_trip_summary_email
tool_definition.description: Dispatches the synthesized executive driving summary to the verified driver email address.

tool_call_payload.subject: [Mobility AI] Trip Summary Report: Seoul to Gyeongju
tool_call_payload.summary_content: Completed 352.4 km in 3h 48m. Eco-score: 88/100 (Top 12%). Saved 22 mins via Daejeon bypass detour.

scenarios.agent_voice_response: Your driving summary is ready. Email delivery is simulated in this prototype, so no message was actually sent. Have a wonderful time exploring Gyeongju!
